## Determining sparsity level with the highest enrichment for DE genes

Summarize nTargets per TF across cell types

```{r}
cutoffs <- c(0.01, 0.015, 0.02, 0.025, 0.03, 0.035)
target_list <-list()
all_list <- list()
for(c in cutoffs){
  print(c)
  lung_grn <-
    lapply(ct_order, function(i) {
      f <- fread(sprintf("%s/sparsity%s/L_%s_GRN.txt", data_dir, c, i))
      return(lapply(split(f, f$Regulator), function(i){i$Target}))
    })
  names(lung_grn) <- ct_order
  target_list[[as.character(c)]] <- lung_grn
  all_genes <-
     lapply(ct_order, function(i) {
      f <- fread(sprintf("%s/sparsity%s/L_%s_GRN.txt", data_dir, c, i))
      return(unique(f$Target))
    })
  names(all_genes) <- ct_order
  all_list[[as.character(c)]] <- all_genes
}

nTargets_tbl <- c()
for(i in names(target_list)) {
  for(j in names(target_list[[i]])) {
    nTargets_tbl <- 
      rbind(nTargets_tbl, 
        data.frame(
      cutoff = i,
      CellType = j,
      nTargets = median(unlist(lapply(target_list[[i]][[j]], length)))
    ))
  }
}
```

```{r}
EnrichmentTest <- function(var1, var2, bkg){
  # fisher exact test
  mat <- matrix(
    c(length(intersect(var1, var2)),
      length(intersect(setdiff(bkg, var2), var1)),
      length(intersect(setdiff(bkg, var1), var2)),
      length(intersect(setdiff(bkg, var1), setdiff(bkg, var2)))
    ), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  print(mat)
  res <- fisher.test(mat)
  out <- data.frame(
    p_value = format(res$p.value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 2),
    odds_ratio = round(res$estimate, 2),
    conf_low = round(res$conf.int[1], 2),
    conf_high = round(res$conf.int[2], 2)
    #method = res$method
  )
  return(out)
}
```

### CD8+ T marker TFs enriched for DE genes compared to random genes

```{r}
set.seed(101)
ct <- "L_CD8_T"
#marker_expr <- fread(sprintf("../output/u19_multiomics/output/DE_analysis_wilcox/%s_DE_results.csv", gsub("L_", "", ct)))
#marker_expr <- fread("~/cluster/projects/u19_multiomics/output/DE_analysis_wilcox/Memory_B_cells_DE_results.csv")
colnames(marker_expr)[1] <- "gene"
known_TFs <- c("RUNX3", "TBX21", "EOMES", "IRF4", "BACH2", "TCF7", "E2F1", "BATF3")
DEGenes <- 
  marker_expr %>% 
    #mutate(gene = rownames(marker_expr)) %>%
    filter(p_val_adj <= 0.05 & avg_log2FC >= 0.58) %>%
    pull(gene)

enrich_out <- 
  lapply(names(target_list), function(i) {
    f_markers <- fread(sprintf("~/projects/Lung_scMultiomics_paper/analysis/dictys/sparsity%s/lung_GRN_regulatory_markers.csv", i))
    markers <- f_markers$RegMarker[f_markers$CellType == ct]
    print(markers)
    out = c()
    for(j in markers) {
        target <- unique(target_list[[i]][[ct]][[j]])
        random <- sample(all_genes[[gsub("L_", "", ct)]], length(target))
        targetDE <- intersect(target, DEGenes)
        randomDE <- intersect(random, DEGenes)
        out = rbind(out, c(length(targetDE), length(randomDE), length(targetDE)/length(randomDE)))
    }
    colnames(out) <- c("nTargetDE", "nRandomDE", "Enrichment")
    return(data.frame(out, TF = markers, cutoff = i))
  })

enrich_out <-
  do.call(rbind, enrich_out) %>% 
    na.replace(0) %>%
    mutate(Enrichment = ifelse(is.infinite(Enrichment), 
                               max(Enrichment[!is.infinite(Enrichment)]), 
                               Enrichment))

count_tbl <- 
  enrich_out %>% 
    group_by(cutoff) %>% 
      summarise(numEnriched= sum(Enrichment > 1),
                numNotEnriched = sum(Enrichment < 2)) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(totalTFs = sum(c_across(c(numEnriched, numNotEnriched))),
             propEnriched = numEnriched/totalTFs,
             propNotEnriched = numNotEnriched/totalTFs)


ggplot(
  enrich_out,
  aes(x = Enrichment,
      fill = cutoff)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, type = "dashed") + 
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.7) + 
  facet_grid(cutoff ~.) + 
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) + 
  #ggtitle("CD4+ T marker TFs") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")
  
```

Make it stronger case by examining effect size between TF regulation and DE genes

```{r}
grn_tbl <- fread("../analysis/dictys/sparsity0.02/L_CD4_T_GRN.txt")
par(mfrow = c(2,3))
out_tbl <- c()
for(i in enrich_out$TF){
  grn_sub <-
    grn_tbl %>% filter(Regulator == i & Strength > 0) %>%
      dplyr::select(Target, Strength)
  common <- intersect(grn_sub$Target, lung_up$gene[lung_up$cluster == "CD4_T"])
  grn_sub <- grn_sub[grn_sub$Target %in% common, ]
  #DE_genes <- gginput %>% filter(cluster == "CD4_T" & gene %in% common)
  DE_genes <- lung_up %>% filter(cluster == "CD4_T" & gene %in% common)
  grn_sub$DE <- DE_genes$avg_log2FC[match(common, DE_genes$gene)]
  if(nrow(grn_sub) < 3) {
    next
  }
  model = lm(grn_sub$DE ~ grn_sub$Strength)
  out_tbl = rbind(out_tbl, c(i, round(coef(summary(model))[2, ], 2)))
  coeff = as.numeric(coefficients(model))
  plot(x = grn_sub$Strength, y = grn_sub$DE,
       xlab="", ylab="", cex = 0.8,
       main = i, cex.axis = 1.5,
       pch = 20)
  abline(a = coeff[1], b = coeff[2])
}

```

## Identifying master regulators for asthma

```{r}

# Other option: testing all marker TFs with 100 or more targets
#novel_TFs <- tf_tbl$TF[tf_tbl$FDR <= 0.15]
sparsity = "0.015"
idx <- which(sapply(target_list[[sparsity]][["CD4_T"]], function(i){length(i) >= 100}) == TRUE)
regTFs <- unique(names(target_list[[sparsity]][["CD4_T"]])[idx])

tf_tbl <- c()
for(ct in ct_order) {
  #regTFs <- novel_TFs
  # test enrichment for asthma risk genes across marker TFs
  idx <- which(sapply(target_list$`0.015`[[ct]], function(i){length(i) >= 100}) == TRUE)
  regTFs <- unique(names(target_list$`0.015`[[ct]])[idx])
  gene_set <- gene_scores$Gene
  out_tbl <-
    lapply(regTFs, function(i){
      target = unique(target_list[[sparsity]][[ct]][[i]])
      return(EnrichmentTest(var1 = target, var2 = gene_set, bkg = all_list[[sparsity]][[ct]]))
    })
  out_tbl <- do.call(rbind, out_tbl)
  #rownames(out_tbl) <- sprintf("%s(%s)", regTFs$gene, regTFs$CellType)
  out_tbl <- data.frame(TF = regTFs, out_tbl)
  tf_tbl <- rbind(
    tf_tbl,
    data.frame(
      out_tbl,
      CellType = ct,
      FDR = p.adjust(out_tbl$p_value, method = "fdr"),
      row.names = NULL
    ))
}
```

Enrichment analyses for peaks with TCF7 motifs

The motif file in Dictys outputs was limited to peaks with footprints. Use the motif enrichment in ArchR pipeline instead. 
```{r}
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
load("../output/u19_multiomics/output/peakCalling/peaks_called_by_TissueCellType.RData")
proj <- addMotifAnnotations(ArchRProj = proj, motifSet = "cisbp", name = "Motif", force = TRUE)
pSet <- getPeakSet(ArchRProj = proj)
pSet$name <- paste(seqnames(pSet), start(pSet), end(pSet), sep = "_")
matches <- getMatches(ArchRProj = proj, name = "Motif")
rownames(matches) <- paste(seqnames(matches), start(matches), end(matches), sep = "_")
matches <- matches[pSet$name]
# find peaks with TCF7 motifs
idx = grep("TCF7", colnames(matches))[1]
peak_set <-pSet[which(matches@assays@data@listData$matches[, idx] == TRUE)]
sub_pSet <- subsetByOverlaps(peak_set, d_major$Lung_CD4_T, type = "equal")
coa <- readRDS("~/cluster/projects/u19_multiomics/data/coa_gp3_finemapping_gwas_L5.rds")
coa_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = paste0("chr", coa$chr),
                IRanges(start = coa$pos,
                        end = coa$pos+1),
                pval = coa$pval)
ch=import.chain("~/resources/genomes/chain_files/hg19ToHg38.over.chain")
seqlevelsStyle(coa_gr) <- "UCSC"
snp_gr <- unlist(liftOver(coa_gr, ch))
snpInMotif <- snp_gr[findOverlaps(snp_gr, sub_pSet + 250, type = "within")@from]
snpAll <- subsetByOverlaps(snp_gr, sub_pSet + 500000, type = "within")
snpOutMotif <- snpAll[setdiff(1:length(snpAll), findOverlaps(snpInMotif, snpAll)@to)]
snpOutMotif <- subsetByOverlaps(snpOutMotif, d_major$Lung_CD4_T)

plot(y = -log10(sort(snpOutMotif$pval)), 
     x = -log10((1:length(snpOutMotif))/length(snpOutMotif)),
     xlab = "-log10(Expected p-value)", ylab = "-log10(Observed p-value)",
     main = "SNPs in peaks with (red) or without TCF7 motif (black")
points(y = -log10(sort(snpInMotif$pval)),
      x = -log10(1:length(snpInMotif$pval)/length(snpInMotif)),
      col = "red")
```

```{r}
compute_enrichment <- function(positives, bkg_genes, risk_genes) {
  positive_prop = length(intersect(risk_genes, positives)) / length(positives)
  negatives = setdiff(bkg_genes, positives)
  negative_prop = length(intersect(risk_genes, negatives)) / length(negatives)
  return(positive_prop / negative_prop)
}
```

```{r}
  regTF_targets <-

    list(regTF_targets = unique(regTF_targets),
         common_targets = unique(common_targets),
         all_targets = union(regTF_targets, common_targets))
```

```{r}
select_ct = c("CD8_T", "CD4_T", "Memory_B", "Naive_B")
```

```{r}
motifs
```

chromVAR is designed for predicting enrichment of TF activity on a per-cell basis from sparse chromatin accessibility data.

-   output per-cell TF motif deviation score
-   take into account insertion sequence bias of Tn5 transposase
-   "deviations" - how far the per-cell accessibility of a given motif deviates from the expected accessibility based on the average
-   "z-scores" - absolute deviation score normalized by read depth

```{r}
# compute ChromVAR deviations
proj <- addBgdPeaks(proj, force = TRUE)
proj <- addDeviationsMatrix(
  ArchRProj = proj, 
  peakAnnotation = "Motif",
  force = TRUE
)

plotVarDev <- getVarDeviations(proj, name = "MotifMatrix", plot = TRUE)
saveArchRProject(proj)
```
